title: The Ogre Traitor
html:
Quest chain · part 2 of 2, the last one
1Cargo for the Isle→2The Ogre Traitor→🔓 Access to Ogre Isle
The shipment was meant for the Ogres on Ogre Isle and one of their own took it. They call him the Traitor for that, and they want him dead before anything else crosses.

About

Given byGerald Seabroden
Level34
LengthLong
KindStory
Quest points3
UnlocksAccess to Ogre Isle
RequiresCargo for the Isle finished first

What you need

Not known yet: the data for this quest is incomplete.

Steps

  1. Talk to Gerald Seabroden (outdoors near Plymouth Wharf) to get the quest.
  2. Kill the Ogre Traitor inside the - a level 34 boss at the bottom of the den (level 45 before 26 Sep 2026).
  3. Go back to Gerald Seabroden to finish the quest.

Rewards

Reward
Gold1,360
Character XP59,500
Quest points3

Unlocks

Ogre Isle

Finishing it earns the crossing to Ogre Isle, so the whole island and everything on it opens up. Gerald Seabroden sends you to the dock: “You’ve earned the crossing.” The ferry out costs 50 gold, and the way back is free.

Found only there: Gaunt Ogre Lv 33, Ogre Mauler Lv 38, Ogre Butcher Lv 40, Ogre Charger Lv 42, Ogre Shaman Lv 44, Ogre Elder Lv 46.

Places: Ogre Cove.

Since 26 Sep 2026 Ogre Isle is a level 30 area (it was 45). From the Binxonia news: The Exchange Opens (13 Sep 2026), Ogre Isle Opens at Thirty (26 Sep 2026).

What Gerald Seabroden says

Gerald Seabroden: Word travels fast out there. They knew before you did, probably.

Gerald Seabroden: Robbing his own kin. That is what it took to earn that name with them.

Gerald Seabroden: Get down to the dock. You've earned the crossing.

Handing it in

"The water's quiet for the first time in years. Dock's this way."

The Ogre Traitor
